A yellow flag means the flagman has called
a caution period because an accident
or debris on the track makes driving
conditions dangerous. When drivers see a
yellow flag, they know they must slow down
to line up and drive cautiously around the
track until the track has been cleared.
Drivers must stop on the track - in a
designated area - when they see the
